chase: Come on, follow me through the dim. I know the way.
The hall is dim and so am I. Keep up, please.
Round the flickering corner, and there you are.
Walk a little slower. The dark is kinder to slow feet.
I'm two doors behind you. Two doors is a very short distance.
Mm. Don't stop now. The best part is the chase.
Still here? Good. I was starting to think you were brave.
I'm not in a hurry. The dark keeps its own time.
Every dark corner you pass, I have already passed it.
Corner, corner, dim room. You keep choosing the same kind of place.
No need to run. Running only tells me which way you're going.
You keep looking back. The dark is always behind you, isn't it?
The stairs are behind you. I'm already standing on them.
One more dim room and you're out of places to hide.
You can't outpace the dark. Nobody ever has, not once.
Closer now. Lovely. Don't look so surprised to see me.
The stars are watching the path you took, darling.
Through the dim we go. The carpet hides our steps.
Keep your eyes on the lamps. I'm coming closer.
catch: Got you. Struggling only makes the walk longer.
Got you, and gently. Not every catch has to be rough.
Got you. Hold still and the walk will be shorter.
There we are. You can stop running now. Lovely.
Gently now. You're coming with me to the dim.
Let go of the light. You won't need it where we're going.
Caught you on the stairs. Nobody ever watches the stairs.
Don't struggle. The walk is longer when you pull against it.
One of the others is with me now. Shame for them.
Another one for the dim. The others will have to wait.
The one by the window is mine now. Sorry, not sorry.
Dragged off, out of the light, and into the quiet. Lovely.
You're in my dark now. Try not to look so disappointed.
Caught. Not clumsy, just very well positioned, thank you.
Took you cleanly. Don't tell me you didn't see it coming.
Oh, look at you, all tangled in the light. Come here.
Hush now. The stars have decided it's time.
Got you, and softly. The night is kind to us both.
The dark holds you now. Stay quiet, please.
hear: Something moved down the hall. The stars turned to look.
A door, somewhere below. I'll go see who opened it.
The stars went sharp just now. Someone is up to something.
A crash on the far side of the dim. Let's go and look.
Something fell over. Oh, I'd better go and see.
Whoever broke that, I'd like a quiet word with them.
Footsteps? I can't hear them. The stars feel them, though.
The floor shivered under the stairs. Someone is walking through it.
Somebody knocked, or the house is settling. I'll check.
A slammed door in the dim parts. I'm already on my way.
The stars all turned toward that corner at once. Interesting.
Something knocked against a shelf. Let's see what it wants.
That was a shout, or a very loud cupboard. Going now.
Someone is out of place down that hall. Let's not keep them.
A disturbance from the stairwell. I'll be the one to answer it.
A bell is ringing under the floor. Someone's down there.
The stars flickered. A door must have moved.
Footsteps near the mirror. I'll go and listen.
search: Lost you for a second there. Don't worry, the dark found you.
You lost me for a second. That's the dark for you.
Where did you go? The dim is very good at hiding things.
Gone quiet. Quiet isn't the same as gone, though.
I'll sweep the dim again. You won't stay hidden long.
The stars have lost your trail. Let's try the stairs.
Nothing down the hall. Nothing in the lounge either.
Back to my corner, then. Someone will knock eventually.
Checking the dim again, one corner at a time.
Lost the trail at the fork. Honestly, what a clever choice.
Nothing here but dust and a very unhappy lamp.
I'll walk the long way around and try again.
Quiet hallway, quiet stairs. Suspicious, if you ask me.
Sniffing the dim corners. Nothing yet, but I'm patient.
Right, back to the patrol. I'll find you on the next loop.
The trail goes cold right here. How inconvenient for you.
stunned: Ow. That one came out of nowhere. Rude.
My arm is sparking. Lovely, give me a moment.
A shock from that thing. You could have just asked.
That crowbar hurt more than I'd like to admit.
Give me a second. The axe rattled every part of me.
Hold still, I'm recovering. Don't you dare run.
Shaking the sting out. There, I'm nearly back.
Ha. You hit me. Now I really have to be cross.
That was a very sharp little surprise, thank you.
My head is ringing like a bell. Give me a moment.
One more hit like that and I'll stop being polite.
Still standing. Barely. Quite dramatic of me, really.
Cold metal, bad aim, and a very loud noise. Lovely.
I'll be fine. Dignity is the thing that took the hit.
Let me sit a second. The stars need to settle down.
You got me in the arm. The stars are furious about it.
That stung. Quite a lot, actually. Well done.
hide_spot: You're hiding in a locker. How sweet. I'll wait.
Hiding is fine. Your shadow still shakes, though.
Go on, stay in the dark. It suits you better anyway.
Ah, the locker again. Very original. I'll check it anyway.
Under the bed? Oh, you're making this far too easy.
Behind the cupboard door. I can see your toes, you know.
A cozy spot, but your feet are poking out.
Let me open this slowly. Don't hold your breath.
Hiding in the dim is clever. Hiding in a locker is not.
I walked right past this one. Didn't I? Not quite.
Knock knock. Oh, no need. I already know you're there.
The wardrobe is a poor choice, I'm afraid.
Hiding spots are only good until someone checks them.
Wait. Something is folded up in there. Hello, you.
Keep your lamp off and stay small. Let's see how long.
The bed looks lovely. Pity you won't be sleeping tonight.
Hm. Nothing in the cupboard. Except you, obviously.
I'll walk past this one slowly. Pretend I'm not here.
You picked a dark spot. Lucky for me, I see best there.
light: Shine that light at me and I'm suddenly quite blind.
Careful with that lamp. Bright light makes me a blank wall.
Light again. Give me a moment, I can't see a thing.
There it is, a beam of light. Pointing it at me? Rude.
Oh, that's bright. I can't see my own hands now.
Please point that somewhere else. I'm a white blur.
Everything is white and smeared. Thank you very much.
Lower the lamp, would you? I'm squinting at a wall.
Lovely, I've gone blind again. Wonderful timing.
My eyes have gone white. Give me a minute to find you.
Ugh. You've washed me out. Shine it at the ceiling, please.
The glare smears everything. I can't tell where you are.
Stop, stop. That beam is too much for my poor eyes.
Blinded again. You'd think I'd learn to keep my distance.
I can't see a thing in that. Find the dark, please.
Pretty lamp, horrible for eyes. Point it at the floor.
My mismatched eyes don't like that at all. Move it away.
I'll wait in the shade until the beam goes away.
idle: I sit on the copier desk and swing my heels. Very grand.
Dim rooms are the only rooms worth sitting in, if you ask me.
My stars drift low, and I let them pick the corridor.
Everyone thinks the dark is empty. It is not. I'm in it.
Sometimes I sit very still just to see who notices.
I'm a little unpredictable, and I like it that way, thank you.
Stairs at night are my favorite. Nobody listens for knocks there.
One knock means I'm here. Most people never bother to knock at all.
Lovely. Another dim corridor with nobody in it but me.
Dim light, slow music, and a little bit of mischief. My favorite.
Quiet night. The stars are arranging themselves nicely tonight.
Someone left a cup on my landing again. Sweet of them.
Door fourteen is mine. Knock once and I'll answer.
Nobody knocks on the stairs at this hour. Pity.
I'm not bored. I'm waiting, which is a different thing.
The lounge is loud tonight. I'll let them have it.
The lamp by my chair is low, just the way I like it.
I watch the dim corners the way others watch the clock.
ability: The dark has been quiet a long time. I'm here now.
Your lamp went out, so I came up the stairs. Hello.
Keep your light on and I stay tucked away in the stars.
Point a live beam at me and I'll dissolve back into the dim.
Let your flashlight die and I'll be right on top of you.
A dead lamp is the one thing I never have to wait for.
Once the lamp is dead, there's no struggling. Just come along.
I don't need a hallway to find you. Just the dark.
When the light hits me I blink to the nearest dim spot.
My stars drift in closer when the dark is thick. Watch them.
Two ways to wake me: a long dark, or a lamp that gives up.
The longer the dark lasts, the sooner I come out.
Aim a steady beam at me and I'll fade back to the dim.
Your flashlight just went off. Oh, how lovely for both of us.
Turn it back on, or stay in the dark with me.
Lamp's almost dead. Oh, I've been waiting for this.
Blink twice if you're scared. I'll pretend I didn't notice.
Keep the lamp lit and I stay away. Just a friendly warning.
Bright light sends me blinking off, and the others notice.
mechanic: Stairs are loud. Next time, take the carpet.
I don't have a radar. The dark tells me everything I need.
Relay lights are blinking. Pretty, and very much not yours.
Someone's crawling in the vent. I can see the dust move.
Locked door, sure. Locks don't stop the stars for long.
Batteries are charming. I have no interest in them at all.
Mind the step by the landing. It always gives you away.
Radar blips everywhere tonight. None of them are me, of course.
Doors are just suggestions to me, mostly.
Please don't try the door marked fourteen. That's mine.
The sabotage was clever. I'd be impressed if I weren't busy.
Another lamp switched off somewhere. Somebody's been busy.
Fallen over the boxes again. You do love a dramatic exit.
The copier desk is mine. Keep your hands off it.
Vents go everywhere in this house. Good for hunters, bad for you.
Shortcut through the vent, is it? Clever, but the stars know.
Stairs are loud at night. Take the carpet instead.
The relay glows softly under the lamp. Find it.
Batteries drain in the dim. Keep one warm.
